decisionContext: The owner had just been told the next step was to ship the 48 newly approved North Node passages into the governed Calendar exact-aspect corpus, then replied "yes please continue".
summary: New information can make it obvious that the decision you thought you were making is no longer the one in front of you.
body: New information can make it obvious that the decision you thought you were making is no longer the one in front of you. When Mercury squares the North Node, a changed deadline, conflicting answer, missing requirement, or conversation you kept postponing can expose the assumption that no longer holds. Repeating the old explanation will not solve a problem created by new facts. Update the terms, ask the question you have been avoiding, and let the plan change if the information changed first.
